answer: Offers last only a limited time, so after an expiration you may need to get a new offer while you wait for your North Carolina duplicate title. We can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives. The help center doesn't say whether a new offer would match your old price, or how long offers last, so please contact a store about that. Also, in North Carolina your registration must be current on the day of the sale, so renew it before your appointment if needed.
